blocks.text: Capulet sees inspections: the full record, findings and photos included.
Montague sees the routing envelope: who sent an event, where it's going, when it was sent. Not the findings.
Ducal sees only its own sites. Nothing from Montague's routing data.
Same line I gave Paris this morning: Ducal sees only what Ducal sends.
Every Mesh Routing event is an envelope plus a body (from Montague's docs).
id: made on the device. Also what the receiver uses to ignore repeats.
sender, destination: where the event comes from and where it goes.
schema_version: the version of the body's format, so the receiver knows how to read it.
sent_at: when the event left the device. Not the same as signed_at.
The inspection record is the body. That part is Capulet's.
